[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Talahon''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Talahon served in [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]].
